relations.subject: Frederick William Thomas
relations.evidence: He was a librarian at the India Office Library (now subsumed into the British Library) between 1898 and 1927.

relations.subject: Frederick William Thomas
relations.evidence: Simultaneously he was lecturer in comparative philology at University College, London from 1908 to 1935
